title.label: There's a bug where the screen doesn't lock as long as it's running in the background.

content.label:
Ever since I installed this software, I've noticed my phone won't lock anymore. I tried all sorts of things, including adjusting the screen timeout in the system settings, but nothing worked. I figured it had to be caused by this app.

After tracing the issue back, I realized this problem only started after I installed it—it never happened before. When I force-closed it in the background, my screen locking went right back to normal. So this has got to be a bug, and I hope the developers can push out a fix for it quickly.

Also, why doesn't the mobile app have the other AI features that the desktop app has? Here we only have voice input and translation, without the actual AI capabilities.
